nodes.description: Evaluates EVCC state machine position and SECC history

Enforces schema constraints, catching tracebacks and self-healing

Transmits winning candidate to IXXAT CAN / SECC testbed
Detects behavioral distress signals and calculates reward
Propagates rewards back into the multi-armed bandit distribution
